title: Petition of H.T. Drummond, Inc. of 22 McClelland Road, Halifax, Massachusetts, pursuant to provisions of G.L. c. 159A, § 1, as amended by Chapter 740 of the Acts of 1975, requesting that the Department of Public Utilities act as a licensing authority for the City of Boston to grant the petitioner a license to operate motor vehicles for the carriage of passengers for hire over certain public ways in the City of Boston.
